title: Propiedad list and show views
description: Build a read-only property inventory section. Advisors browse propiedades to match them with leads. The list shows key fields from propiedades_summary. The show page displays all 58 fields organized by section (location, price/size, broker info, NocNok metadata). No create/edit UI — propiedades are populated exclusively by the Sheet sync (TASK-013). Register the propiedades resource in CRM.tsx with list and show only.
acceptance_criteria: src/components/atomic-crm/propiedades/PropiedadList.tsx renders a list with columns: nombre, tipo badge, operacion badge, precio formatted as MXN currency, activa status, fuente
src/components/atomic-crm/propiedades/PropiedadListFilter.tsx filters by tipo, operacion, activa, fuente

src/components/atomic-crm/propiedades/PropiedadShow.tsx displays all Propiedad fields grouped into sections: Identificacion, Ubicacion, Precio y Caracteristicas, Argumentos y Descripcion, Info Broker, Metadatos
No create or edit route is registered for propiedades in CRM.tsx
src/components/atomic-crm/root/CRM.tsx registers a 'propiedades' Resource with list=PropiedadList and show=PropiedadShow
PropiedadList is accessible from the lead show page as a related resource panel (link to propiedad show from LeadShow via propiedad_interes field)

non_functional_requirements.security: Read access is open to all authenticated users (no per-advisor restriction on propiedades in Phase 1)
